title: Add Pollen Village - Roblox NPC dialogue to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]

gist.summary: Added Pollen Village to the games catalog and README. Its Roblox Luau module gives an NPC a persona and lets it answer nearby players using any Pollinations text model, posting replies as both a speech bubble and a chat line. The API key stays in Roblox's secrets store; Sage is the example NPC.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art village garden, a small Sage NPC chats with a player while a speech bubble and chat line appear beside them; Polli hovers nearby wearing a tiny village-guide scarf. Polli is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she has consistent, non-elongated proportions and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients over prominent lime green (#ecf874) and warm cream, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, and a few pixel flowers.
